research_result.description: Higgsfield is a multi-model generative AI platform for creating images, video, audio, and 3D media through a unified asynchronous API, SDKs, CLI, and hosted MCP server.
research_result.credential_requirements: Users can sign up at cloud.higgsfield.ai and generate API credentials (API Key and Secret) via the developer dashboard. Alternatively, Higgsfield MCP connects directly using OAuth authorization without an API key. A limited free tier is available, while programmatic and full model access deducts plan credits or requires paid subscriptions.

evidence.claim: Higgsfield provides a REST API authenticated using an API Key and Secret via the Authorization header.
Higgsfield offers direct REST API access as well as official Python and Node.js/TypeScript SDKs.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: We provide official Python and Node.js/TypeScript SDKs. You can also integrate directly through the REST API from any language with an HTTP client.

evidence.claim: Higgsfield provides a hosted MCP server for AI agents that connects via OAuth authorization.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: No. MCP connects through OAuth authorization, no API key is needed.

evidence.claim: Developers can explore the Higgsfield platform on a free tier without purchasing a subscription.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You can explore the platform on the free tier with a limited set of models, and upgrade when you're ready.
